meta.title: Bengaluru property-tax exception scenarios official-source pass
meta.disclaimer: Research handoff, not official advice. It records public rules and portal boundaries; do not submit personal or property data through this ledger.

agencies.name: Greater Bengaluru Authority / Bengaluru City Corporations Revenue Department

scenarios.label: Death or succession
scenarios.summary: A successor seeks mutation after the person primarily liable for the property tax has died.

scenarios.label: Missing or incorrect property record
scenarios.summary: A property record or deed/EC relationship cannot be verified or the recorded information needs correction.

scenarios.label: Property not found
scenarios.summary: The property cannot be located through the public e-Aasthi search controls.

scenarios.label: Payment or name discrepancy
scenarios.summary: A transfer-payment or property-tax name/receipt discrepancy needs an official recovery handoff.

sources.title: BBMP Property Tax Assessment, Recovery and Management Rules, 2024
sources.publisher: Government of Karnataka / Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike
sources.notes: Existing verified official Rules PDF reused by exact URL. Rule 10 and Forms 21–24 cover succession/intake, notice, objection, and conditional e-Khata order text. This pass did not submit a form or verify an individual property's eligibility.

sources.title: e-Aasthi public eKhata search
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Current public page observed. It exposes Ward Name/Number, property ePID, and SAS Property Tax ID searches and says a person who cannot find a property can select Do Not Find My Property eKhata for the corporation to check and revert. No search or submission was made.

sources.title: eKhata Application Status
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Current public page observed. It asks for an EPID, exposes stage/routing/date/status/remarks columns, renders a default No Data Available row with no EPID, and publishes eKhata helpline 9480683695. No EPID was entered.

sources.title: e-Aasthi Pending Mutation Report
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Current public page observed. It labels an Aadhaar-based automatic-mutation report and shows basis options including registered deed, inheritance, court order, and bank order, plus EPID, parties, notice, pending-with-whom, and File Objection columns. The unfiltered page displayed No Data Available; no case data was entered.

sources.title: e-Aasthi Upload EC Document
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Current public page observed. It exposes PropertyId/ePID lookup, EC upload, and a statement that an application will not be processed when its registered deed number is absent from the submitted EC; it directs users unable to fetch EC details to the respective ARO. No identifier or file was provided.

sources.title: Online payment for Khatha Transfer
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Current public payment screen observed without property context. It displays property/applicant/amount labels, payment modes, and notices for online-payment failure/auto-refund and a payment deducted but not updated in e-Aasthi. No payment was attempted.

sources.title: Online Khatha Download (BBMP)
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Current public page observed. It repeats the bank and ARO recovery notices for online payment issues and provides Revenue contact details. No property number or already-paid route was used.

sources.title: BBMP Property Tax System — Online Grievance
sources.publisher: Greater Bengaluru Authority / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Current public page observed. It states that receipt discrepancies and name-related queries use Find Your ARO, exposes an Online Grievance form with application/name/mobile/email and OTP controls, and identifies its version as 01-04-2026/13.1-1. No values or OTP were entered.

claims.text: Rule 10 of the BBMP Property Tax Assessment, Recovery and Management Rules, 2024 prescribes Form 21 for an inheritor, survivor, or successor after death.
claims.notes: The prescribed form does not prove a current public online submission flow, successor eligibility, document acceptance, or an issued mutation.

claims.text: Rule 10 of the BBMP Property Tax Assessment, Recovery and Management Rules, 2024 permits mutation information from a Sub-Registrar Form 18 intimation, an authorised-officer or court order, or information supplied by an interested person.
claims.notes: This rule states intake bases; it does not identify which one a particular property or public portal route will accept.

claims.text: Rule 10 and Form 23 of the BBMP Property Tax Assessment, Recovery and Management Rules, 2024 provide at least fifteen days for an objection to a published mutation entry, in writing or online.
claims.notes: No notice, objection, or property-specific response was observed.

claims.text: Rule 10 and Form 24 of the BBMP Property Tax Assessment, Recovery and Management Rules, 2024 state that an authorised officer may certify a mutation and issue an e-Khata order when no objection is received within the notice period.
claims.notes: This is a conditional rule, not an approval promise, service-level time, or property-specific outcome.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi Pending Mutation Report lists inheritance as one of the displayed bases of mutation.
claims.notes: A visible report label is not evidence that a successor's record exists, qualifies for automatic mutation, or can be completed online.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi search exposes Ward Name/Number, property ePID, and SAS Property Tax ID lookup controls.
claims.notes: No identifier, ward, owner name, or property result was entered or retrieved.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi search says a person who cannot find a property can select Do Not Find My Property eKhata for Bengaluru City Corporation to check and revert.
claims.notes: No details were submitted, so fields, response channel, review owner, and timing remain unknown.

claims.text: The current public eKhata Application Status page requires an EPID and exposes stage, routing, date, status, and remarks columns.
claims.notes: No EPID was entered, so no property-specific status, error, or ownership state is asserted.

claims.text: The unqueried public eKhata Application Status page renders No Data Available by default.
claims.notes: This default display is not a diagnosis that a particular EPID is invalid, missing, or incorrectly owned.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi EC-upload page says an application will not be processed if its registered deed number is not in the submitted encumbrance certificate.
claims.notes: No deed number, EC, upload, or processing result was supplied; this is a public validation condition, not a case result.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi EC-upload page directs a user unable to fetch EC details to the respective ARO.
claims.notes: The source does not state how the ARO resolves a case or how long resolution takes.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi transfer-payment and download notices direct online-payment failure or auto-refund issues to the user's bank.
claims.notes: No payment, bank contact, refund, or timing was observed.

claims.text: The current public e-Aasthi transfer-payment and download notices direct a user whose payment was deducted but not updated in e-Aasthi to contact the ARO with details.
claims.notes: The notices do not state the required details, refund timing, or a guaranteed reconciliation outcome.

claims.text: The current BBMP Property Tax System grievance page directs receipt discrepancies, name-related queries, and related queries to Find Your ARO.
claims.notes: The source exposes the official handoff, not a name-correction document checklist or completed correction.

claims.text: The current BBMP Property Tax System page exposes an Online Grievance form with application, taxpayer-name, mobile, email, and OTP controls.
claims.notes: No values or OTP were entered. The page does not establish that this form accepts or resolves a particular e-Aasthi/khata transfer discrepancy.

claims.text: This pass did not establish a property-specific succession decision, record correction, missing-property response, payment reconciliation, name correction, mutation certification, or e-Khata order.
claims.notes: No login, OTP, property identifier, EC, form, objection, payment, or submission was used.

nodes.label: Mutation intake
nodes.summary: Published Rule 10 intake bases and public inheritance/EC-validation leads; property-specific routing and acceptance are unobserved.
nodes.requiredState: Identify a valid rule-based succession, order, intimation, interested-person, or EC/deed basis through an authorised route before any submission.

checks.label: Succession Form 21 lead
checks.description: The 2024 Rules prescribe Form 21 for an inheritor, survivor, or successor after death.

checks.label: Rule 10 intake bases
checks.description: The 2024 Rules identify Form 18 intimation, authorised/court order, and interested-person information as mutation-information bases.

checks.label: Public inheritance report label
checks.description: The public pending-mutation report lists inheritance among the displayed mutation bases.

failureSignals.label: Registered deed number absent from EC
failureSignals.description: The EC-upload page says the application will not be processed if the registered deed number is not in the submitted EC.

recoveries.label: Contact the respective ARO for EC details
recoveries.description: The EC-upload page directs users unable to fetch EC details to the respective ARO; no resolution process was tested.

nodes.label: Notice and objection
nodes.summary: The 2024 Rules provide a public-notice and objection opportunity; no individual notice or objection was observed.
nodes.requiredState: A mutation notice must exist before an objection period or case outcome can be determined.

checks.label: Form 23 objection period
checks.description: Rule 10/Form 23 provides at least fifteen days to object in writing or online.

nodes.label: Property-tax register record
nodes.summary: Rule 10/Form 24 describes the conditional mutation-certification and e-Khata-order outcome after the notice period.
nodes.requiredState: No property-specific certification, register entry, or e-Khata order was observed.

checks.label: Conditional Form 24 outcome
checks.description: Rule 10/Form 24 allows certification and an e-Khata order if no objection is received within the notice period.

nodes.label: Public property lookup
nodes.summary: Public e-Aasthi lookup offers multiple identifiers but no property-specific result was requested.
nodes.requiredState: Use a legitimate ward, ePID, or SAS property-tax ID; this pass did not enter one.

checks.label: Ward/ePID/SAS search controls
checks.description: The public e-Aasthi page exposes lookup controls for ward, property ePID, and SAS Property Tax ID.

failureSignals.label: Property not found in public search
failureSignals.description: The public e-Aasthi page expressly provides a fallback for a property not found in its searches.

recoveries.label: Do Not Find My Property eKhata
recoveries.description: The public page says Bengaluru City Corporation will check and revert after the named route is used; no route was submitted.

nodes.label: Missing-property recovery
nodes.summary: The public fallback is visible, but no fields, response, or review outcome were reached in this pass.
nodes.requiredState: A missing-property request is not asserted until a user legitimately supplies the required details through the official route.

recoveries.label: Corporation check and revert statement
recoveries.description: The search page describes a corporation check-and-revert response for the named missing-property route, without a published timing or case result.

nodes.label: Public e-Khata status
nodes.summary: The public EPID status screen exposes fields but cannot diagnose a property without an entered EPID.
nodes.requiredState: A legitimate EPID is needed for a property-specific status; none was entered.

checks.label: EPID status fields
checks.description: The public status page requests an EPID and exposes routing, date, status, and remarks columns.

failureSignals.label: Default No Data Available
failureSignals.description: The unqueried screen renders No Data Available; it is not a property-specific invalid-EPID or ownership finding.

nodes.label: Khatha transfer payment
nodes.summary: Public payment notices name bank and ARO handoffs, but no property-specific demand, payment, or refund was observed.
nodes.requiredState: Payment applicability, amount, transaction state, and recovery facts remain case-specific.

failureSignals.label: Online payment failure or auto-refund
failureSignals.description: The public notices direct online-payment failure or auto-refund issues to the bank.

failureSignals.label: Payment deducted but not updated
failureSignals.description: The public notices identify a payment deducted but not updated in e-Aasthi state.

recoveries.label: Contact the bank
recoveries.description: The public notices route online-payment failure or auto-refund issues to the bank; no refund outcome was tested.

recoveries.label: Contact the ARO with details
recoveries.description: The public notices direct deducted-but-not-updated payment cases to the ARO with details; no evidence list or result is stated.

nodes.label: ARO correction or recovery
nodes.summary: Official public pages direct EC, payment, receipt, and name-related cases to the respective or Find Your ARO route.
nodes.requiredState: The jurisdictional ARO and a current remedy remain unknown without case facts; no grievance or contact action was taken.

checks.label: Name and receipt discrepancy ARO handoff
checks.description: The Property Tax System grievance page directs receipt discrepancies and name-related queries to Find Your ARO.

checks.label: Online Grievance controls
checks.description: The official page exposes application, taxpayer-name, mobile, email, and OTP controls without proving that a particular discrepancy is eligible.

recoveries.label: Use Find Your ARO
recoveries.description: The current Property Tax System page names Find Your ARO for receipt and name-related discrepancies; current document requirements and resolution are unknown.

roadblocks.title: Exception-route case result is not public
roadblocks.symptom: Public rules and screens identify succession, search, EC, payment, and ARO handoffs but do not expose a property-specific decision or correction result without case data.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Eligibility, identifiers, evidence, payment, notice, and authorised review are case-specific and were not entered or submitted in this pass.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the applicable exact official route and preserve the resulting official acknowledgement or status; do not infer an outcome from public labels or default no-data screens.
